title: Egg omelet with potatoes and/or onions

content.title: About
content.content: Egg omelet with potatoes and/or onions is a simple dish made from eggs, sautéed potatoes and onions. Eggs provide protein and nutrients, while potatoes and onions add carbohydrates, fiber, and flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The omelet can be cooked in a skillet or baked in the oven.
Potatoes make the dish more filling and supply starch that helps bind the ingredients.
Onions give a sweet aroma and contain compounds that support heart health.
In Russian cuisine this dish is traditionally known as “домашний омлет”.
Quick preparation makes it a popular breakfast for busy people.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Eggs are an excellent source of complete protein needed for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Eggs contain B12, riboflavin and folate, which support energy metabolism and the nervous system.

items.title: Potassium and magnesium
items.content: Potatoes provide potassium, while onions supply magnesium, both important for muscle and heart function.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Onions contain quercetin and egg yolk provides lutein, helping protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Satiety support
items.content: The combination of protein, fat and complex carbs promotes lasting fullness.

items.title: Egg allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to egg whites.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: Adding large amounts of oil or cheese can make the omelet calorie‑dense.

items.title: Cholesterol content
items.content: Egg yolk contains cholesterol; people with high cholesterol should consume it in moderation.

items.title: Sodium levels
items.content: Excessive salt in seasoning may raise blood pressure.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the omelet hot, often garnished with herbs, sour cream or tomato sauce. It can be eaten alone or paired with bread, salad, or vegetable sides.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Best enjoyed fresh. If needed, store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours and reheat before serving.
